summary: Frontend smoke test for reviews-with-photos, legal pages, and regression on admin counters, home social links, visit counter, and QR share. All requested flows PASS. Only one non-blocking issue found: direct deep-link to /admin URL race-conditions with token load causing 401 (works fine when navigated via Profile > Admin Dashboard).

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: load() useEffect fires on mount and calls /admin/overview before AuthContext restores memToken from AsyncStorage on a cold page load. Direct deep-link to /admin returns 401 and spinner never resolves. In-app navigation (Profile > Admin Dashboard) works because user/token are already loaded. Fix: gate load() on `user?.role === 'admin'` and add `user` to the effect deps.

issues: Weekly Poll modal appears on top of home content on every session and blocks tab bar hits until manually dismissed via poll-close. Consider showing at most once per week (respect voted state) or lower z-index so bottom tabs remain clickable.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In app/admin/index.tsx, guard load() with `if (!user || user.role !== 'admin') return;` and add `user` to the useEffect dep array so /admin deep-links work after cold start. Not blocking for typical in-app navigation.
OPTIONAL: Poll modal should skip re-opening once user has voted or dismissed within the same week (persist state).
critical_code_review_comments: AsyncStorage on web goes through IndexedDB; ensure any auth-gated screen either waits for auth boot or guards its initial fetch on `user` being populated (same pattern applies to any admin/*-only screens).
seed_data_creation: Posted one automation review on GreenThumb Landscapes (rating 4, text 'Automation test review — great work!') during Test 2. This bumped review_count from 3 to 4 and rating to 4.8. Consider cleanup if desired.

Use that contractor for review-photo tests. Also: after login the Weekly Poll modal blocks tab bar taps; close via `[data-testid="poll-close"]` before navigating.
rca_of_issue: Admin deep-link 401: apiFetch attaches Authorization only if in-memory memToken is set. On a full page load, memToken is reset to null and rehydrated asynchronously by AuthContext.checkExisting -> loadToken(). AdminDashboard's initial useEffect runs load() immediately, racing ahead of loadToken(), so /admin/overview is called without Authorization header. Fix by guarding on `user` (which is only populated after loadToken + /auth/me) or awaiting loadToken() before any fetches.
